senses.gloss:
कौश 1. कौश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुश), made of
Kuśa grass; (अम्), n., scil. नगर, the town of
Kuśa, an epithet of Kānyakubja.
—कौशाम्भस्
(˚श-अम्˚), अस्, n. Kuśa grass boiled in water.

कौश 2. कौश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कोश), silken,
silk.
कौश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, made of Kuśa grass.
कौश्य कौश्य. See under 1. कौश.

कौष्य कौष्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from
Koṣa.

1. कौशिक, अस्, ई, अम्, being in a sheath or scab-
bard, sheathed, incased; silken, silk; (अस्), m. one
who is versed in dictionaries; the compiler of a
dictionary, a lexicographer; the fragrant substance
bdellium; marrow; (आ), f. a drinking-vessel.

कौशिक 2. कौशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुशिक),
of the family of Kuśika &c.; (अस्), m. a patronymic
of Viśvā-mitra, who was the son or grandson of Ku-
śika; N. of a teacher, author of the Sūtras of the
Atharva-veda; a brother of Paippalādi; N. of a
grammarian; N. of one of Jarāsandha's generals; an
epithet of Indra (as originally perhaps belonging to the
Kuśikas or friendly to them); N. of a son of Vasu-
deva; N. of an Asura; an epithet of Śiva; N. of
the plant Vatica Robusta [cf. कुशिक and अश्व-
कर्ण]; an ichneumon; an owl; love, passion; (ई),
f., N. of a river in Bahar, commonly called Kosi or
Koosa, created by Viśvā-mitra, or identified with
Satyavatī, the sister of Viśvā-mitra; an epithet of the
goddess Durgā; N. of a Buddhist female beggar
or परि-व्राजिका; (अस्, ई, अम्), coming from an owl.
—कौशिक-प्रिय, अस्, m. an epithet of Rāma.
—कौशिक-फल, अस्, m. the cocoa-nut tree, (said
to have been created by the sage Viśvā-mitra when
endeavouring to form a human being in rivalry of
Brahmā, the nut being the rudiment of the head.)
—कौशिकाङ्गुलि, इस्, m., N. of a teacher.
—कौशि-
कात्मज (˚क-आत्˚), अस्, m. Indra's son, an epithet of
Arjuna.
—कौशिकायुध (˚क-आय्˚), अम्, n. the bow
of Indra, the rainbow.
—कौशिकाराति (˚क-अर्˚), इस्,
m. an enemy of owls, a crow; also कौशिकारि, &c.
—कौशिकी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
—कौ-
शिक्य्-ओज अस्, m. (ओज = ओजस्), N. of a tree, = शाखोटा.
1. कौशिक; add — (अम्), n. a silk garment.
कौशेय कौशेय. See under 2. कौश.
कौषेय कौषेय. See under 2. कौश.

कौशल कौशल, अम्, n. (fr. कुशल), well-
being, welfare, good fortune, happiness, prosperity;
skilfulness, cleverness, experience; (ई), f. friendly
inquiry, greeting, salutation; a respectful present, a
Nazr; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
कौशलिका, f. a present, a respectful gift or offering.

कौशल्य, अम्, n. welfare, well-being, good for-
tune, prosperity; cleverness, experience; (आ), f. see
कौसल्य.

कौसल्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. कोसल), belonging to
the people of the Kosalas; (अस्), m. a prince of the
Kosalas; (आ), f. the daughter of a prince of the
Kosalas, the wife of Pūru and mother of Janamejaya;
the wife of Satvat; the wife of Daśa-ratha and mother
of Rāma; epithet of the mother of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra;
of the mother of Pāṇḍu.
—कोसल्या-नन्दन, अस्,
m. and कोसल्या-मातृ, ता, m. an epithet of Rāma.

कौशाम्ब कौशाम्ब, अम्, n. (fr. कुशाम्ब),
N. of a realm; (ई), f., N. of an ancient city on the
Ganges in the lower part of the Doab, in the vicinity
of Kurrah; also वत्स-पत्तन.
कौशाम्बेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Kuśāmba.
कौशाम्ब्य, अस्, m. the chief of Kauśambī.

कौशाश्वी कौशाश्वी, f., N. of a town built
by Kuśāśva.

कौशिकायनि, इस्, m. (a patronymic fr. कौशिक),
N. of a teacher.
कौशिकिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the pupils of Kauśika.

कौशिकार कौशिकार, अस्, m. = कोश-कार,
q. v.
कौशिज कौशिज, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कौशीतकी कौशीतकी = कौषीतकी, q. v.
कौषीतकि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Kuṣītaka.

कौशीधान्य कौशीधान्य, अम्, n. (fr. कोशी-
धान्य), a leguminous plant, pulse.

कौशीलव कौशीलव or कौशीलव्य, अम्, n. (fr.
कुशीलव), the profession of an actor, a dancer, &c.

कौषारव कौषारव, अस्, m. (fr. कुषारु),
a patronymic of Maitreya.

कौषीतक कौषीतक, अस्, m. (fr. कुषीतक),
a patronymic of Kahoḍa; (ई), f. a patronymic of the
wife of Agastya; N. of a school derived from Kuṣī-
taka; (अम्), n., N. of a work.

कौषीतकिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the pupils of Kauṣī-
taka.
—कौषीतकि-ब्राह्मण, अम्, n., N. of a
Brāhmaṇa.

कौषीतकेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of a Kāśyapa;
a patronymic of Kahoḍa.

कौष्ठ कौष्ठ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कोष्ठ), being
in a store-room, &c.

कौष्ठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the stomach or
abdomen.

कौष्ठिल कौष्ठिल in महा-कौष्ठिल, अस्,
m., N. of a Buddhist author.

कौसलक कौसलक, आस्, m. pl. (fr. कोसल),
N. of a people; (sometimes spelt कौशलक.)

कौसलेय, अस्, m. (fr. कौसल्या), a metronymic
of Rāma as son of Kausalyā.
कौसल्यायनि, इस्, m. a metronymic of Rāma.

कौसिद कौसिद, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुसिद), relat-
ing or belonging to or coming from a Kusida, q. v.

कौसीद कौसीद, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुसीद), con-
nected with or relating to a loan; usurious.

कौसीद्य, अम्, n. sloth, indolence; the practice
of usury.

कौसुम कौसुम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुसुम),
flowery, flowering; (अम्), n. the ashes of brass, used
as a collyrium.

कौसुमायुध, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुसुमायुध),
relating to the god of love.

कौसुम्भ कौसुम्भ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुसुम्भ),
prepared with safflower; dyed with safflower, orange,
red; (अस्), m. wild safflower.

कौसुरुबिन्द कौसुरुबिन्द, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
कुसुरुबिन्द), N. of a Daśa-rātra.

कौस्तुभ कौस्तुभ, अस्, m. (fr. कुस्तुभ ?),
N. of a celebrated jewel obtained with thirteen other
precious things at the churning of the ocean and
suspended on the breast of Kṛṣṇa; a manner of
joining the fingers; (अम्), n. a kind of oil (सर्ष-
पोद्भव).
—कौस्तुभ-लक्षण, अस्, or कौ-
स्तुभ-लक्षक, अस्, m. or कौस्तुभ-वक्षस्, आस्,
m. a N. of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.

कौस्थलपुर कौस्थलपुर, अम्, n., N. of a
town.
